Meaning drift in the first heading: "SALINANBUPATI SAROLANGUN" was translated as "COPY REGENT OF SAROLANGUN"; it should reflect "Copy of the Regent of Sarolangun" (i.e., a copy of the document), not "copy regent".

Minor meaning drift/terminology: "Pembentukan Peraturan Perundang-Undangan" is more accurately "Formation/Establishment of Laws and Regulations" rather than "Formulation of Legislation" (appears in items 8 and 15).
Scrambled/merged list numbering in Article 1: item 9 is run into item 8 ("...women. 9. Gender...")
Scrambled/merged lettered list items in Article 2: "andi." is merged into the previous item instead of being a separate "i." item
Scrambled/merged lettered list items in Article 3: items c. and d. are merged into the previous text ("...quality; c." and "...systems; andd.")
Scrambled/merged lettered list items in Article 4: item k. is merged into the previous text ("andk.")
Scrambled/merged sub-items in Article 5(1): the "a." marker is merged into the preceding text ("right to:a.") and "k." is merged ("andk.")

Broken/scrambled list structure in Article 5(1): in the original, the lettered items a–k are inline within item (1) (e.g., "1. ...:a."); the translation reformats them as an indented sublist, changing the marker structure used for downstream splitting.
Minor meaning drift in Article 5(1)(f): "bebas dari perbudakan atau diperhamba" is better rendered as "free from slavery or servitude" (not "slavery or enslavement").

Scrambled/merged list markers: several lettered items are concatenated with preceding text (e.g., 'include:a.', 'andc.', 'andd.', 'and/or g.', 'ande.', 'andf.') causing list structure to be unclear for downstream splitting.
Minor meaning drift/wording: Article 13(2) 'kebutuhan hidup yang layak' should be 'decent living needs/standard of living' (not 'a decent living' as an object).

Scrambled/incorrect list structure in Article 7(2): original has 'meliputi:a.' with items a, b, c; translation reformats but OK; however original text has merged 'danc.': must be rendered as 'and c.' (already) — no issue. Main issue is Article 15 list marker formatting: item b and c are merged in translation ('b. child identity card.  c.') instead of separate items, which breaks list structure for downstream splitting.

Broken list formatting/extra blank lines that separate markers from content: Article 8 and Article 9/10/12/14/15/16/17/18 contain blank lines that split list markers from their content blocks; Article 8 has 'and' on its own line and 'd. law.' separated, which can be parsed incorrectly.
Minor meaning drift in Article 16(e): original 'tidak mengekspose' = 'does not expose/publicize'; translation 'does not expose' is acceptable; no change needed. No other meaning drift found.

Scrambled/merged list markers: multiple items are concatenated (e.g., 'ande.', 'by: a.'; 'andh.', 'andi.', 'andg.', 'andl.'), and in Article 27(3) items 'm.' and 'n.' are merged; this breaks list structure required for downstream splitting.
Broken list/numbering structure in Article 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27(3), 29 where lettered items are not consistently on their own markers/lines as in the original.
Minor meaning drift/clarity risk from merged markers (e.g., Article 19 'and e.'; Article 27(3) 'm.'/'n.'), which can cause item boundaries to be misread.

Scrambled list/numbering structure in the original: several list markers are merged (e.g., 'dane.','danh.','dangi.','dang.','andl.') and must be separated into distinct items (d and e; g and h; h and i; f and g; and l). The English translation regularized these, but downstream requires the same marker sequence as the original.

Meaning drift: Article 20(b) in the original says welfare support is provided to all children; the translation says the Regional Government provides it (reasonable from context) but the original list is within the Regional Government clause—OK. Main meaning issue is structural: merged markers in the source imply missing explicit markers; corrected translation must reflect the intended separate items while preserving order.

# BAB IV

## RUMAH AMAN

#### Pasal 30

1. Perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan yang membutuhkan penanganan  berkelanjutan berhak untuk tinggal di rumah aman.  
2. Rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) memberikan tempat atau  penampungan aman sementara bagi korban kekerasan sampai dengan  haknya dipulihkan.  
3. Penyelenggaraan dan pengelolaan rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh perangkat daerah yang menyelenggarakan fungsi  dibidang pemberdayaan perempuan dan anak.  
4. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai penyelenggaraan rumah aman sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.

# BAB V

## KABUPATEN LAYAK ANAK

#### Pasal 31

1. Dalam rangka implementasi pemenuhan hak layak anak dan berbagai  peraturan perundang-undangan serta kebijakan terkait pemenuhan hak anak  dan perlindungan khusus anak, Pemerintah Daerah, Swasta dan Lembaga  Masyarakat melakukan upaya mewujudkan Kabupaten Layak Anak.  
2. Untuk mewujudkan Kabupaten Layak Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) Pemerintah Daerah, Swasta, dan Lembaga Masyarakat  memperhatikan hak anak yang berkaitan dengan hak hidup, tumbuh  kembang, perlindungan, dan partisipasi.  
3. Pemerintah Daerah, Swasta, dan Lembaga Masyarakat dalam mewujudkan  Kabupaten Layak Anak tergabung dalam gugus tugas Kabupaten Layak Anak. (4) Gugus tugas Kabupaten Layak Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3)  bertanggungjawab pada pemenuhan hak anak yang berkaitan dengan: a. hak sipil dan kebebasan;  
b. lingkungan keluarga dan pengasuhan alternatif;  
c. kesehatan dasar dan kesejahteraan;  
d. pendidikan, pemanfaatan waktu luang, dan kegiatan seni budaya; dan e. perlindungan khusus anak.  
5. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai Kabupaten Layak Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.

# BAB VI

## PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN

#### Pasal 32

1. Bupati melaksanakan pembinaan, dan pengawasan penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak di Daerah. (2) Pembinaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang membidangi urusan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.  
3. Perangkat Daerah yang membidangi urusan pemberdayaan perempuan dan  perlindungan anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) merupakan koordinator pelaksanaan penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak di Daerah.

#### Pasal 33

1. Bentuk pembinaan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 32 dapat dilaksanakan dengan kegiatan:a. memberikan sosialisasi kepada masyarakat dan dunia usaha mengenai kebijakan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak; b. menyediakan buku, leaflet, brosur mengenai pemberdayaan perempuan  dan perlindungan anak, dan isu-isu terkait lainnya serta menyebarluaskannya ke masyarakat;  
c. fasilitasi peningkatan kapasitas lembaga pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak;  
d. fasilitasi forum partisipasi perempuan dan organisasi perempuan dan anak;  
e. fasilitasi layanan rehabilitasi dan reintegrasi perempuan dan anak korban diskriminasi, tindak kekerasan dan bencana;  
f. mengkoordinasikan peran serta dunia usaha dan kelembagaan lain, termasuk bantuan internasional bagi pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak; dang. memberikan penghargaan kepada masyarakat dan dunia usaha baik secara individu maupun kelembagaan yang telah melakukan upaya pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.  
2. Bentuk pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 32 dapat berupa kegiatan monitoring dan evaluasi atas pelaksanaan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.

# BAB VII

## PARTISIPASI MASYARAKAT

#### Pasal 34

1. Pemerintah Daerah memiliki kewajiban untuk menguatkan partisipasi masyarakat dalam dalam pembangunan pemberdayaan perempuan dan  Perlindungan Anak.  
2. Partisipasi masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan dalam bentuk:a. sosialisasi;  
b. advokasi;  
c. penyuluhan;  
d. pembinaan;  
e. pengawasan;  
f. fasilitasi;  
g. pelayanan;  
h. kajian;  
i. pelatihan;  
j. permodalan; dank. penyediaan sarana prasarana.  
3. Penguatan partisipasi masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)dapat dilakukan dengan:a. penguatan kerjasama;  
b. penguatan kapasitas kelembagaan pencegahan dan layanan dari masyarakat, pesantren dan dunia usaha; danc. dukungan pembiayaan.

#### Pasal 35

1. Dunia usaha memiliki tanggung jawab dalam pelaksanaan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.  
2. Bentuk tanggung jawab dunia usaha sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (4) dilakukan dalam bentuk:a. bantuan pembiayaan kepada lembaga layanan;  
b. pemberdayaan;  
c. peningkatan kapasitas;  
d. media publikasi dan informasi;  
e. penyediaan sarana prasarana;  
f. pembentukan kelembagaan khusus untuk pencegahan dan pelayanan pengaduan kekerasan; dang. bantuan sosial yang tidak mengikat.

# BAB VIII

## PENGHARGAAN

#### Pasal 36

Bupati dapat memberikan penghargaan kepada lembaga pendidikan, lembaga keagamaan, lembaga penyelenggara pelayanan kesehatan, lembaga profesi dan dunia usaha, lembaga layanan, pesantren, organisasi kepemudaan, organisasi bantuan hukum, komunitas, media yang telah berjasa dalam penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.

# BAB IX

## PEMBIAYAAN

#### Pasal 37

1. Pembiayaan penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak bersumber dari Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah. (2) Selain bersumber dari Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah, Pembiayaan penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak dapat bersumber dari sumber pembiayaan lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat.

# BAB X

## KETENTUAN PENUTUP

#### Pasal 38

Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangkan. Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan pengundangan Peraturan Daerah ini dengan penempatannya dalam Lembaran Daerah Kabupaten Sarolangun.

# CHAPTER IV

## SAFE HOUSE

#### Article 30

1. Women and child victims of violence who require continuous handling have the right to stay in a safe house.  
2. The safe house as referred to in paragraph (1) provides a temporary safe place or shelter for victims of violence until their rights are restored.  
3. The implementation and management of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by regional apparatus that performs functions in the field of women and child empowerment.  
4. Further provisions regarding the implementation of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER V

## CHILD-FRIENDLY REGENCY

#### Article 31

1. In the framework of implementing the fulfillment of child-appropriate rights and various laws and regulations as well as policies related to the fulfillment of children's rights and special protection of children, the Regional Government, Private Sector and Community Institutions make efforts to realize a Child-Friendly Regency.  
2. To realize a Child-Friendly Regency as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government, Private Sector, and Community Institutions shall pay attention to children's rights related to the right to life, growth and development, protection, and participation.  
3. The Regional Government, Private Sector, and Community Institutions in realizing a Child-Friendly Regency are incorporated in the Child-Friendly Regency task force.  
4. The Child-Friendly Regency task force as referred to in paragraph (3) is responsible for the fulfillment of children's rights related to:
   a. civil rights and freedoms;  
   b. family environment and alternative care;  
   c. basic health and welfare;  
   d. education, use of leisure time, and cultural arts activities; and  
   e. special protection of children.  
5. Further provisions regarding the Child-Friendly Regency as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER VI

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 32

1. The Regent carries out guidance and supervision of the implementation of women empowerment and child protection in the Region.  
2. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus in charge of women empowerment and child protection affairs.  
3. The Regional Apparatus in charge of women empowerment and child protection affairs as referred to in paragraph (2) is the coordinator for the implementation of women empowerment and child protection in the Region.

#### Article 33

1. The form of guidance as referred to in Article 32 may be carried out through activities:
   a. providing socialization to the community and business world regarding policies on women empowerment and child protection;  
   b. providing books, leaflets, brochures regarding women empowerment and child protection, and other related issues and disseminating them to the community;  
   c. facilitating capacity building of women empowerment and child protection institutions;  
   d. facilitating forums for women's participation and women's and children's organizations;  
   e. facilitating rehabilitation and reintegration services for women and children victims of discrimination, violence and disasters;  
   f. coordinating the participation of the business world and other institutions, including international assistance for women empowerment and child protection; and  
   g. providing awards to the community and business world both individually and institutionally who have made efforts to empower women and protect children.  
2. The form of supervision as referred to in Article 32 may be in the form of monitoring and evaluation activities on the implementation of policies, programs and activities for women empowerment and child protection.

# CHAPTER VII

## COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

#### Article 34

1. The Regional Government has an obligation to strengthen community participation in the development of women empowerment and Child Protection.  
2. Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:
   a. socialization;  
   b. advocacy;  
   c. counseling;  
   d. guidance;  
   e. supervision;  
   f. facilitation;  
   g. services;  
   h. studies;  
   i. training;  
   j. capital; and  
   k. provision of infrastructure.  
3. Strengthening community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out through:
   a. strengthening cooperation;  
   b. strengthening institutional capacity for prevention and services from the community, Islamic boarding schools and the business world; and  
   c. financing support.

#### Article 35

1. The business world has responsibility in the implementation of women empowerment and child protection.  
2. The form of business world responsibility as referred to in paragraph (4) shall be carried out in the form of:
   a. financial assistance to service institutions;  
   b. empowerment;  
   c. capacity building;  
   d. publication and information media;  
   e. provision of infrastructure;  
   f. establishment of special institutions for prevention and violence complaint services; and  
   g. non-binding social assistance.

# CHAPTER VIII

## AWARDS

#### Article 36

The Regent may grant awards to educational institutions, religious institutions, health service provider institutions, professional institutions and the business world, service institutions, Islamic boarding schools, youth organizations, legal aid organizations, communities, media that have contributed to the implementation of women empowerment and child protection.

# CHAPTER IX

## FINANCING

#### Article 37

1. Financing for the implementation of women empowerment and child protection is sourced from the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget.  
2. In addition to being sourced from the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget, financing for the implementation of women empowerment and child protection may be sourced from other legitimate and non-binding sources of financing.

# CHAPTER X

## CLOSING PROVISIONS

#### Article 38

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation. In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Sarolangun Regency.

### A. PENJELASAN UMUM

Pancasila dan Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia  Tahun 1945 telah secara tegas dan nyata memberikan perlindungan  terhadap Hak Asasi Manusia, termasuk hak perempuan dan anak. Setiap  orang mempunyai harkat dan martabat yang sama tidak hanya dijamin oleh  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945, akan tetapi  juga telah diakui secara internasional melalui Universal Declaration of  Human Right atau Deklarasi Universal Hak Asasi Manusia (DUHAM) Tahun  1948 yang secara tegas mengatur tentang pentingnya perlindungan terhadap  Hak Asasi Manusia termasuk didalamnya perlindungan terhadap perempuan  dan anak.  

Untuk menjamin pemenuhan hak perempuan dan anak pemerintah  daerah berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan dan  mendukung kebijakan nasional dalam penyelenggaraan urusan  pemerintahan bidang pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan dan anak  di daerah. Selain itu, pemerintah daerah juga diberi kewajiban untuk  melakukan pengawasan terhadap penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan dan  perlindungan perempuan dan anak tersebut.  

Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan dan  anak merupakan upaya mewujudkan perempuan yang berkemampuan serta  upaya melindungi perempuan dan anak dari segala tindakan kekerasan guna  mencapai tujuan kesejahteraan. Pemberdayaan dan perlindungan  perempuan dan anak yang terlaksana selama ini belum optimal dan  komprehensif dalam menjangkau permasalahan-permasalahan yang  dihadapi perempuan dan anak. Disamping itu, kepedulian masyarakat  terhadap upaya pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan dan anak  masih sangat kurang. Untuk mencapai tujuan tersebut serta melaksanakan  kewenangan pemerintah daerah yang telah dijabarkan di dalam Undang Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan Daerah pada sub urusan pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan dan anak, maka  diperlukan suatu regulasi yang dapat menjadi payung hukum bagi  pemerintah daerah dalam penyelenggaraan urusan pemerintahan bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak di daerah.  

Dalam menyusun kebijakan terkait dengan pemberdayaan  perempuan dan perlindungan anak ini, perlu diperhatikan asas  pembentukan peraturan perundang-undangan yang baik sebagaimana telah  diatur didalam Undang-Undang Nomor 12 Tahun 2011 tentang Pembentukan Peraturan Perundang-undangan meliputi:
r. kejelasan tujuan;  
s. kelembagaan atau pejabat pembentuk yang tepat;  
t. kesesuaian antara jenis, hierarki, dan materi muatan;  
u. dapat dilaksanakan;  
v. kedayagunaan dan kehasilgunaan;  
w. kejelasan rumusan; danx. keterbukaan.  

Disamping asas pembentukan peraturan perundangundangan, perlu  juga memperhatikan asas materi muatan yang meliputi:
a. pengayoman;  
b. kemanusiaan;  
c. kebangsaan;  
d. kekeluargaan;  
e. kenusantaraan;  
f. bhineka tunggal ika;  
g. keadilan;  
h. kesamaan kedudukan dalam hukum dan pemerintahan; i. ketertiban dan kepastian hokum; dan/atauj. keseimbangan, keserasian, dan keselarasan.  

Penyelenggaraan urusan pemerintahan bidang Pemberdayaan  Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak bertujuan meningkatkan upaya  Perlindungan hak perempuan, pemenuhan hak anak dan Perlindungan  Khusus Anak dan meningkatkan peran Pemerintah Daerah dan dunia  usaha, media serta masyarakat dalam upaya Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan  Perlindungan Anak. Adapun materi pokok yang terkandung didalam batang  tubuh Peraturan Daerah tentang Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan dan  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak meliputi:
a. pemenuhan hak perempuan;  
b. pemberdayaan perempuan;  
c. perlindungan perempuan; d. perlindungan anak;  
e. pemenuhan hak anak;  
f. pusat pelayanan terpadu; g. rumah aman;  
h. kabupaten layak anak;  
i. pembinaan dan pengawasan; j. peran serta masyarakat;  
k. penghargaan; danl. pembiayaan.

### A. GENERAL EXPLANATION

Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia have firmly and clearly provided protection for Human Rights, including the rights of women and children. Every person has equal dignity and worth not only guaranteed by the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, but also internationally recognized through the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) of 1948 which expressly regulates the importance of protection of Human Rights including protection of women and children.

To guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of women and children, regional governments have the obligation and responsibility to implement and support national policies in the administration of governmental affairs in the field of empowerment and protection of women and children in the regions. In addition, regional governments are also given the obligation to supervise the administration of empowerment and protection of women and children.

The administration of empowerment and protection of women and children is an effort to realize capable women as well as an effort to protect women and children from all acts of violence in order to achieve the goal of welfare. The empowerment and protection of women and children that has been implemented so far has not been optimal and comprehensive in reaching the problems faced by women and children. In addition, public awareness of efforts to empower and protect women and children is still very lacking. To achieve these objectives and to implement the authority of regional governments as outlined in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government in the sub-affairs of empowerment and protection of women and children, a regulation is needed that can serve as a legal umbrella for regional governments in the administration of governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection in the regions.

In formulating policies related to women's empowerment and child protection, it is necessary to pay attention to the principles of good legislation formation as regulated in Law Number 12 of 2011 concerning Formation of Legislation, including:
r. clarity of purpose;
s. appropriate institution or forming official;
t. conformity between type, hierarchy, and material content;
u. implementability;
v. utility and effectiveness;
w. clarity of formulation; and
x. transparency.

In addition to the principles of legislation formation, it is also necessary to pay attention to the principles of material content which include:
a. protection;
b. humanity;
c. nationality;
d. kinship;
e. archipelago;
f. unity in diversity;
g. justice;
h. equality of position in law and government;
i. order and legal certainty; and/or
j. balance, harmony, and congruence.

The administration of governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection aims to increase efforts to protect women's rights, fulfill children's rights and provide Special Protection for Children and increase the role of Regional Governments and the business world, media and society in efforts to Empower Women and Protect Children. The principal matters contained in the body of the Regional Regulation concerning the Administration of Empowerment and Protection of Women and Children include:
a. fulfillment of women's rights;
b. women's empowerment;
c. protection of women;
d. child protection;
e. fulfillment of children's rights;
f. integrated service center;
g. safe house;
h. child-friendly regency;
i. guidance and supervision;
j. community participation;
k. awards; and
l. financing.
